title: Design: Move Customers greyed without the customer permissions
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has Settings → Finance but not Customers → Create & Edit.
  • Make sure Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the COD row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens: "Make Default for New Customers" is normal and "Move Customers" is greyed.

Step 2:

  • A dark grey box opens to the left of the menu on one line: "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (as in ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N1: “If the user has 'Settings → Finance' but lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Move Customers" shows greyed in every row menu with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." A move sent by other means without all three permissions is refused by the server.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a greyed Move Customers (missing permission) | "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
